eyebrow.zh: 栏目级音色锁 · 章节自动 · 离线起手 · MIT
eyebrow.en: Column voice lock · Auto chapters · Offline start · MIT

headline.zh:
锁一把音色
整个栏目不再漂移
headline.en:
Lock one voice
The whole column stops drifting

sub.zh: 从一段语音样本克隆并锁定栏目音色，写进一个文件；之后这个栏目的每一期都引用同一把音色——不再每篇重新合成、跨期漂移。
sub.en: Clone a column voice from one sample, lock it into a file, and from then on every episode of this column references the same voice — no more per-episode re-synthesis, no more cross-episode drift.

hero.command: lanyin voice lock --sample ./voice.mp3 --name "作者签名音色"

title.zh: 锁一次，整个栏目同一把音色
title.en: Lock once. One voice for the whole column.

body.zh: 通用 TTS 每篇重新合成，第 11 期已经对不上第 3 期。栏音从一段语音样本克隆并锁定音色，写进一个文件；从那以后这把音色就是这个栏目的签名——跨期不再漂移。
body.en: Generic TTS re-synthesizes every episode, so episode 11 no longer matches episode 3. LanYin clones a voice from one sample, locks it into a file, and from then on that voice is this column's signature — no more cross-episode drift.

title.zh: 粘 Markdown，标题自动成章节

body.zh: 章节边界过去靠手贴。把一期公众号文章粘进来，二级标题直接切成章节标记——纯解析、不联网、秒出清单。
body.en: Chapter boundaries used to be hand-stitched. Paste a WeChat episode in and its level-2 headings become chapter marks — pure parsing, no network, an instant list.

title.zh: 要么用锁定的音色，要么明确停下
title.en: Either the locked voice, or a clear stop

body.zh: 音色锁的底线是绝不偷偷换一把。语音接口是这个工具唯一的网络依赖；不可用时直接停下并报清晰错误——绝不静默回退到别的音色，那会破坏整栏的一致性。
body.en: The voice lock's bottom line is never silently swapping in a different voice. The voice API is this tool's only network dependency; when it's down the run halts with a clear error — never a silent fallback that would break the whole column's consistency.

chips: › 唯一网络依赖是音色接口

title.zh: 三行命令，到第一个可见结果
title.en: Three commands to a first visible result

body.zh: 不想跑长流程也能上手：初始化栏目、粘一期文章、回看已锁音色——这三步不需要任何密钥，离线可用；只有克隆新音色时才需要一把 key。
body.en: Get started without running the long pipeline: scaffold a column, paste an episode, re-open the locked voice — these three steps need no key and work offline; only cloning a new voice asks for one.

chips: › 初始化 · 注册 · 回看，离线可用

headline.zh: 给你的栏目一把签名音色
headline.en: Give your column a signature voice

sub.zh: 开源、MIT、一行装好。先把栏目音色锁住。
sub.en: Open source, MIT, one line to install. Lock your column's voice first.
